feedback: Pre-race review of the kd 0.6 to 0.8 step, with kp 3.0, ki 0, base_speed 1.0 and the iteration 0 sensor layout unchanged. Iteration 3 (kd 0.6) is the best raced design at 458.0. Its s-bend progress was 0.72 and slalom 0.23, both up from iteration 2 (kd 0.4). The oval finished 20 of 20 runs. The candidate changes one variable, kd, from that best design, so the next race isolates the effect of kd. The candidate is valid: all sensor positions are inside the allowed ranges, the weights are unchanged at (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), and kd 0.8 is within [0, 10]. Holding base_speed at 1.0 is reasonable, because iteration 3's s-bend finish time of 2.97 s is already near the 3.0 s limit. Speed should be raised only after completions are secure. Iteration 1 showed that widening the sensor array did not reduce max_error, so the candidate correctly keeps the layout. The main risk is that steering_oscillation has grown with kd (oval 0.24, s-bend 0.45 at kd 0.6), so more kd may add jitter. Racing is more informative than another revision at this point, since the bar is already set by a raced design. Do not treat the rationale's expected result as a measured outcome. Once the race reports, use the results as follows. If s-bend and slalom progress rise and the oval still finishes, kd is still improving, so the next step is base_speed 1.2 to recover completion time. If oval finishes fall or steering_oscillation rises sharply with progress flat or falling, kd 0.6 was the peak, so return to it and test ki. If slalom max_error stays near 0.063 with line_loss_events near 1.5, the slalom needs a different lever than more kd.
requested_changes: If s-bend and slalom progress rise above iteration 3 (0.72 and 0.23) and the oval still finishes 20 of 20, keep controller.kd at 0.8 and try controller.base_speed 1.2 to recover completion time, since the iteration 3 s-bend finish took 2.97 s, close to the 3.0 s limit.

If oval finishes fall or steering_oscillation rises sharply (iteration 3 oval 0.24, s-bend 0.45) with progress flat or falling, return to controller.kd 0.6, the best raced value, and test controller.ki at 0.05 to 0.1 for the residual s-bend max_error of 0.061.

If slalom max_error stays near 0.063 with line_loss_events near 1.5 (iteration 3: 1.6), do not add more kd. Try controller.kp in a small step, from 3.0 to about 3.5, keeping kd at the better of 0.6 or 0.8, because slalom progress is the weakest track and iteration 1 showed that a large kp increase alone (5.0 with widened sensors) reduced oval progress.
